movie:1013601.overview: Two of New York's most notorious organized crime bosses, Frank Costello and Vito Genovese, vie for control of the city's streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that will reshape the Mafia (and America) forever.
movie:1013601.tagline: The most dangerous enemy is an old friend.
movie:1013601.title: The Alto Knights

cast.c: The Guy Who Told You to Cross the Wires (voice)

movie:1116201.overview: In a post-apocalyptic future where an event known as "The Quiet Rapture" caused all known stars and habitable planets in the universe to disappear, a convict is sent to search an ocean of blood discovered on a desolate moon, using a small submarine nicknamed the "Iron Lung".
movie:1116201.tagline: This is not an expedition. It's an execution.
movie:1116201.title: Iron Lung

movie:1125701.overview: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.
movie:1125701.tagline: A day they can't forget. A truth they can't escape.
movie:1125701.title: Midwinter Break

movie:1193501.overview: When a misfit group of unwitting high school students stumbles upon a cursed Aztec Death Whistle, they discover that blowing it unleashes a terrifying sound that summons their future deaths to hunt them down.
movie:1193501.title: Whistle

movie:1261501.overview: When he and his pregnant wife are attacked in their home, a former elite agent becomes trapped in a deadly manhunt tied to his own painful past.
movie:1261501.title: Ad Vitam

movie:1397201.overview: As each group pursues their mission, a fierce battle unfolds over the tattooed prisoners. Who is friend, and who is foe? The fight leads them all to Abashiri Prison, where Noppera-bo, the man who holds all the answers, is locked away...
movie:1397201.title: Golden Kamuy -The Abashiri Prison Raid-

movie:1508701.overview: Arturo is a lonely, gluttonous, and disillusioned Sicilian real estate agent. His mundane life finally finds its spark through his one true passion: Sicilian pastries. It’s over a tray of cannoli that he meets his soulmate, Flora. She is everything he ever dreamed of—beautiful, witty, and brilliant. To top it off, she’s a pastry chef.  However, a divine obstacle stands between them: God.  While Flora is a devout, fervent Catholic, Arturo abandoned his faith as a child. Desperate not to lose the woman of his dreams, he decides to "fake it 'til he makes it," pretending to be a man of deep conviction. Guiding Arturo on this chaotic journey toward truth, faith, and Flora’s heart is an unlikely mentor and friend: Pope Francis himself.
movie:1508701.title: God Forgives Everyone

cast.c: Peggy (voice) (as Claudia Martínez de Aguirre Caneda)

movie:1571101.overview: When an alien substance mixes Zoe’s DNA with that of her exotic pets, a hilarious adventure begins where humans turn into animals, animals turn into humans, and everyone must come to an agreement to save the world.
movie:1571101.title: Evolution

movie:1751701.overview: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.
movie:1751701.title: After Impact

movie:203101.overview: In their efforts to find a safe haven from the zombie apocalypse, the gang find themselves on a deserted island. Now, they take advantage of the momentary respite to enjoy some surf, sand and bathing suits!
movie:203101.title: High School of the Dead: Drifters of the Dead

movie:20701.overview: A young boy tells three stories of horror to distract a witch who plans to eat him.
movie:20701.tagline: Four Ghoulish Fables In One Modern Nightmare!
movie:20701.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie

trailer.name: Tales From The Darkside: The Movie (1990) - Official Trailer (HD)

movie:340101.overview: During the Blitz of World War II, a female screenwriter works on a film celebrating England's resilience as a way to buoy a weary populace's spirits. Her efforts to dramatise the true story of two sisters who undertook their own maritime mission to rescue wounded soldiers are met with mixed feelings by a dismissive all-male staff.
movie:340101.tagline: In the fight for freedom everyone played a part.
movie:340101.title: Their Finest

movie:42801.overview: Three tales of very different women using their sexuality as a means to getting what they want.
movie:42801.tagline: They're in Love Three Times and Three Ways...In One Movie!
movie:42801.title: Yesterday, Today and Tomorrow

movie:508101.overview: Longtime single friends, Ben and Alice, agree to be each other's respective plus one at every wedding they're invited to, during a busy summer of wedding fever.
movie:508101.tagline: 10 weddings. 1 summer. No one can survive alone.
movie:508101.title: Plus One

movie:588001.overview: Sara, Lucía, Sofía and Claudia are sisters, 4 modern women with very different personalities, who come together at their mother's funeral, after which they discover the man they've all called "dad" throughout their lives is not really their father. They embark on a quest to discover who their real fathers are, discovering more about themselves, their mother, and their lives.
movie:588001.title: Despite Everything

movie:81401.overview: A look at the monotonous daily struggle of a father and daughter in a windswept, desolate landscape. Over six days, their routine of eating boiled potatoes and tending a failing horse crumbles, symbolizing a slow descent into darkness, emptiness, and the end of existence.
movie:81401.title: The Turin Horse

movie:952701.overview: After an impulsive travel decision to visit friends, Freddie, 25, returns to South Korea for the first time, where she was born before being adopted and raised in France. Freddie suddenly finds herself embarking on an unexpected journey in a country she knows so little about, taking her life in new and unexpected directions.
movie:952701.title: Return to Seoul

tv:124101.overview: Explore a dark mentorship that forms between Deborah Vance, a legendary Las Vegas comedian, and an entitled, outcast 25-year-old.
tv:124101.title: Hacks

tv:138501.overview: Agatha Harkness gathers a coven of witches and sets off down, down, down The Witches' Road.
tv:138501.title: Agatha All Along

tv:231001.overview: Witness the rise of the world's first celebrity chef, Antonin Carême, and his descent into espionage in Napoleon-era France—where manipulation is king. With his gifts for gastronomy and seduction, he becomes the perfect weapon in a fight for power.
tv:231001.title: Carême

tv:254701.overview: When the path of free-spirited drug smuggler Max collides with JJ, an enigmatic outsider on the run, an unlikely friendship is formed. They're swept into a chaotic, high-stakes mission they never signed up for, trafficking highly enriched uranium across North Africa and the Middle East, with the CIA, MI6, and a global web of opposing forces closing in fast.
tv:254701.title: Atomic

tv:258901.overview: In near-future Japan with ultra-low birthrates, children are treasured but monitored. Santa is banned as dangerous. One snowy December 25th, middle-schooler Kazushige Sanda, descendant of Santa, is attacked by classmate Fuyumura who wants him to find her missing friend, Ono. "Santa, please find my friend." To protect children from adults, Sanda decides to become Santa and fight the adults.
tv:258901.title: SANDA

tv:279601.overview: As Christmas approaches, a blundering-all-the-way dad juggles housesitting a posh London penthouse with an unexpected pickle: caring for a lost baby.
tv:279601.title: Man vs Baby

tv:281401.overview: A former ice dancer returns to the rink with an exciting new partner while holding onto feelings for her old one — her first love.
tv:281401.tagline: It's a thin line between love and skate.
tv:281401.title: Finding Her Edge

tv:285801.overview: Amber, a brilliant thief, arrives on Isla Esperanza with the aim of stealing the valuable Tiara of Santa Águeda, but her plan is complicated by the unexpected reappearance of Rui, her former partner who did not hesitate to betray her in the past. Now, the hardest thing will be to trust each other and accept that love may be the biggest treasure of their lives.
tv:285801.title: Suspicious Minds

tv:286801.overview: The shocking true-life tale of Ed Gein, the infamous murderer and grave robber who inspired many of Hollywood's most iconic on-screen killers.
tv:286801.tagline: Before The Texas Chainsaw Massacre... there was Ed.
tv:286801.title: Monster: The Ed Gein Story

tv:301001.overview: Betrayed by her husband, a woman must step up and run an erotic magazine that becomes a symbol of empowerment in '70s Rome. Inspired by true events.
tv:301001.title: Mrs Playmen

tv:314501.overview: Lobo Rosales, a former detective, becomes a guardian to the daughter of a woman he once loved. He must flee with young Renata when he discovers that she holds the key to a hidden fortune that many criminals are willing to kill to find.
tv:314501.title: Wolf: Die Killing

tv:33001.overview: FBI agent Audrey Parker arrives in the small town of Haven, Maine to solve a murder and soon discovers the town's many secrets—which also hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of her lost past.
tv:33001.tagline: It takes a village to hide a secret
tv:33001.title: Haven

tv:332401.overview: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.
tv:332401.title: City of Blood

tv:333101.overview: Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.
tv:333101.title: Treasure Island

tv:43901.overview: A Wyoming sheriff rebuilds his life and career following the death of his wife. Based on the “Walt Longmire” series of mystery novels written by best-selling author Craig Johnson.
tv:43901.title: Longmire

tv:4601.overview: The third installment of the “Law & Order” franchise takes viewers deep into the minds of its criminals while following the intense psychological approaches the Major Case Squad uses to solve its crimes.
tv:4601.title: Law & Order: Criminal Intent

tv:63401.overview: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized  society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends,  or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice  Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the  hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the  siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By  their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human  character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka  Bigfoot.
tv:63401.title: We Bare Bears

trailer.name: We Bare Bears (Volume 1): Viral Video - Official Trailer

tv:79501.overview: The Doom Patrol’s members each suffered horrible accidents that gave them superhuman abilities — but also left them scarred and disfigured. Traumatized and downtrodden, the team found purpose through The Chief, who brought them together to investigate the weirdest phenomena in existence — and to protect Earth from what they find.
tv:79501.title: Doom Patrol

tv:91801.overview: Fourteen-year-old Iruma Suzuki has just been abandoned and sold to a demon by his irresponsible parents! Surprisingly, the next thing he knows he's living with the demon who has adopted him as his new grandson and has been transferred into a school in the Netherworld where his new demon grandfather works as the principal. Thus begins the cowardly Iruma-kun's extraordinary school life among the otherworldly as he faces his true self, takes on challenges, and rises to become someone great.
tv:91801.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
